_comment: Declarative manifest of every guard hook that must be registered in USER-scope Claude Code settings (~/.claude/settings.json) so it fires for a session whose project root is some other repo entirely - a project-level entry in this repo's own .claude/settings.json never loads there. Reconciled by bin/lib/sync-user-hooks.py at every session-creation choke point (bin/wingman, bin/spawn-crew, bin/crew-resume), so a merged guard is an active guard with no human step in between (issue #241). bin/doctor registers the identical set today via bin/lib/install-user-hook.py; tests/doctor.test.sh's manifest/doctor equality test keeps the two from drifting apart until bin/doctor is refactored to read this file directly (a deferred follow-up). Script paths are repo-relative, resolved against --repo at read time. ok_text/warn_text/blurb exist so that future refactor can drive bin/doctor's own reporting from this file without changing a single user-visible string; the reconciler itself never reads them.

blurb: blocks direct Edit/Write/test-runner calls at wingman's top-level session and any lead, machine-wide
records Artifact publishes and gates crew deliverable reports on them, for crew sessions in any repo, machine-wide
denies crew-session merges by default and attributes any authorized one, for crew sessions in any repo, machine-wide
marks every PR a crew member opens with the same attribution marker, for crew sessions in any repo, machine-wide
denies killing a live watch-fleet cycle from any session, machine-wide
denies a foreground or detached watch-fleet/pr-watch arm from any session, machine-wide
denies a foreground while/until+sleep polling loop from any session, machine-wide
denies AskUserQuestion/EnterPlanMode/ExitPlanMode from every crew session, for crew sessions in any repo, machine-wide
pauses new bin/spawn-crew calls while a fleet-wide API outage is active, for crew sessions in any repo, machine-wide

denies new bin/spawn-crew calls while a fleet-wide usage-quota window is approaching its cap, for crew sessions in any repo, machine-wide - the statusLine half of this detection pair (bin/lib/usage-statusline.py) is not a hook and stays registered by bin/doctor only
restricts bin/spawn-crew to orchestrator-type callers (wingman/lead), for crew sessions in any repo, machine-wide
extends the project-scope fleet-continuity constraint to crew sessions in any repo, machine-wide (a lead's own session gets the same no-idle-blind guarantee)
surfaces a denied tool call (toolDenialKind: user-rejected) a crew session would otherwise silently absorb, machine-wide (any repo a lead/worker runs in)
